reading.body:
This entry is a probable mistag: a point tagged as a data center that reads, from its name alone, as a small Italian professional-services office.

The name carries two signals. "Studio" in Italian business usage commonly denotes a practice in architecture, engineering, accounting, or design. "Srl" is the standard suffix for a limited-liability company. Neither implies hosting, colocation, or any commercial compute business. The OpenStreetMap tag telecom=data_center most plausibly captured the firm's own office IT rather than a facility that sells capacity.

That distinction matters for anyone counting data centers as a proxy for compute supply. A professional office runs a handful of servers for itself. It adds no megawatts and no leasable capacity. The record lists zero megawatts, which is consistent with either a very small facility or, as the naming evidence suggests, no facility at all.

What this does not establish is what Studio Delta Srl actually does. The research status is exhausted and the search quota ran out before the firm's line of business could be confirmed, so the mistag conclusion rests on naming convention rather than verification. The point sits near Parma, about 19.5 miles from Parma Airport, and that location is the only physical fact the entry carries.
